To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pegged exchange rate is a credible commitment to a fiscal policy rule.

pegged exchange rate regimes are a form of monetary reform that, in the presence of fiscal dominance, can lead to the following sequence of events: (1) a boom in the tradables sector; (2) a boom in non-tradables; (3) a boom in real estate; and (4) an increase in inflation.
the peg is a commitment device to reduce the expected fiscal deficit, and that the peg is not credible if the deficit is too high.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
understanding the consequences of the change in expectations about fiscal policy that tend be associated with the adoption of the exchange rate peg.
the following questions: Why do countries peg their currencies?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the peg does not cause the boom, but it is a necessary condition for the boom.
a peg can be a good idea, but it is not a good idea to peg.

the empirical regularities associated with the pegs are not necessarily a consequence of the peg per se, but rather of the changes in the fiscal policy that tend, in practice, to be associated with them.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pegging the exchange rate is a way to commit the government to a set of policies.
the peg is a commitment device that can help to implement fiscal discipline.
the peg is a commitment device that allows the authorities to credibly commit to a set of policies that are not sustainable under the pre-peg regime.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the changes in fiscal behavior associated with the peg tend to have the same effects on the macroeconomic variables that are observed empirically.

the changes in fiscal policy that tend be associated with the adoption of a peg, can help explaining the observed changes in relative prices, the reallocation of resources and the boom in the real state sector that are observed following the peg.
a peg is likely to lead to an improvement in the current account only if the government is committed to a fiscal consolidation.
